proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.old_html: "Thirty, and if I fail, I work contracts through you until the balance is cleared."
proposals.new_html: "Thirty, and if I fail, I work contracts through you until the balance is cleared." I said.
proposals.current: "Thirty, and if I fail, I work contracts through you until the balance is cleared."
proposals.following: His expression changed. There it was. Me. A Bronze adventurer was cheap. A Bronze adventurer volunteering his future labor while talking like a merchant was interesting.

proposals.speaker: Senna
proposals.following: The table laughed. I smiled. She did not.

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.new_html: "Do you have a better term?" I asked.

proposals.speaker: You
proposals.new_html: "Then he still needs twelve total." You said.
proposals.previous: "Because if you lend five and he keeps one, he has reserve."

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.following: Fair. But something had shifted. I was no longer trying to impress Antonius. That was new. I wanted to understand him. Different impulse. Cleaner. Questions became less performative when I did not need the answer to prove something about Greg. At one point I realized I had gone almost an hour without thinking about my build. No warrior plan. No Barrier timeline. No gambling bankroll.

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.old_html: "You put a severed-looking hand on a table before breakfast."
proposals.new_html: "You put a severed-looking hand on a table before breakfast." I said.
proposals.previous: "I put a gauntlet on a table."
proposals.current: "You put a severed-looking hand on a table before breakfast."

proposals.speaker: Arlo
proposals.new_html: "You didn't know what it was." Arlo said.
proposals.following: "I knew it wasn't going to bite me."

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.old_html: "Would he mistake decorative armor for a ward tool?"
proposals.new_html: "Would he mistake decorative armor for a ward tool?" I asked.
proposals.current: "Would he mistake decorative armor for a ward tool?"

proposals.speaker: Antonius
proposals.new_html: "You don't know whether it works." Antonius said.

proposals.speaker: Hessa
proposals.old_html: "That sentence has caused most of your problems."
proposals.new_html: "That sentence has caused most of your problems." Hessa said.
proposals.current: "That sentence has caused most of your problems."
proposals.following: Fair. I closed them. Hold. The shape came to me before I invited it. Barrier. Not the spell. The idea of the spell. Plane. Boundary.

proposals.speaker: Arlo
proposals.old_html: "If I spend two days learning from it, I get something."
proposals.new_html: "If I spend two days learning from it, I get something." Arlo said.
proposals.current: "If I spend two days learning from it, I get something."

proposals.speaker: Arlo
proposals.previous: "Because you would otherwise spend those two days earning money."

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.following: "I was trying to get you out."

proposals.speaker: Hessa
proposals.old_html: "Because eventually the world will be visible while you cast."
proposals.new_html: "Because eventually the world will be visible while you cast." Hessa said.
proposals.current: "Because eventually the world will be visible while you cast."

proposals.speaker: Hessa
proposals.following: Because defense had forty years attached to it. My body did not. The instant an object moved toward me, old Greg arrived with a complete answer. Barrier. Angle. Reinforcement. Counterposition. Too much. All at once. The spell had collapsed under instructions my channels could not execute.

proposals.speaker: Jorren
proposals.following: I took front. The next half mile was uneventful. Then I saw a man beside the road.

proposals.speaker: Jorren
proposals.new_html: "You didn't interrogate the turnip man." Jorren said.

proposals.speaker: You
proposals.following: I considered whether preventing a future historical tragedy justified murder on a public road.

proposals.speaker: Alden
proposals.new_html: "Your face goes somewhere else." Alden said.

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.previous: “Waste. Residual tension. Sometimes a rebound if the structure is under load.”
proposals.following: She smiled for the first time.

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.following: “It is more useful than inventing one.”

proposals.speaker: Antonius
proposals.old_html: “Because merchants lie to guards differently than they lie to creditors.”
proposals.new_html: “Because merchants lie to guards differently than they lie to creditors.” Antonius said.
proposals.current: “Because merchants lie to guards differently than they lie to creditors.”

proposals.speaker: Rusk
proposals.new_html: “Hook boy cheats at school.” Rusk said.

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.previous: “You followed me to a warehouse because of a goat.”

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.old_html: “Or it pulls us over the wall and there are two more.”
proposals.new_html: “Or it pulls us over the wall and there are two more.” I said.
proposals.current: “Or it pulls us over the wall and there are two more.”
proposals.following: Branches moved. Closer. Cal backed toward the wagon. Good. Not agreement. Compliance. Enough. The driver had a knife out and was cutting a twisted trace.

proposals.speaker: Cal
proposals.following: I looked at the dead creature. Then the horses. Then the orchard walls. Then the relief canvas.

proposals.speaker: Alden
proposals.old_html: “Yes. No casting until someone rechecks you.”
proposals.new_html: “Yes. No casting until someone rechecks you.” Alden said.
proposals.current: “Yes. No casting until someone rechecks you.”

proposals.speaker: Nemi
proposals.following: Alden shifted beside me. I could feel him getting bored. Not bored exactly. Restless. We had nearly died an hour ago and I was discussing sternums. That was a me problem. Doven tapped the map.

proposals.speaker: Senn
proposals.old_html: “Back door sticks. Kitchen window opens outward. Stairs turn right. My mother sleeps downstairs because of her knee. Mira’s room is above.”
proposals.new_html: “Back door sticks. Kitchen window opens outward. Stairs turn right. My mother sleeps downstairs because of her knee. Mira’s room is above.” Senn said.
proposals.current: “Back door sticks. Kitchen window opens outward. Stairs turn right. My mother sleeps downstairs because of her knee. Mira’s room is above.”

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.following: Cal understood. He moved sideways. Creature’s head followed. Not Mira. Movement. Maybe. Jory transferred Mira to Cal. Creature tracked Cal. No. Tracked Mira? Could not tell.

proposals.speaker: Senn
proposals.new_html: “She went upstairs during a breach.” Senn said.

proposals.speaker: Alden
proposals.old_html: “You rode in a boat on a wagon.”
proposals.new_html: “You rode in a boat on a wagon.” Alden said.
proposals.current: “You rode in a boat on a wagon.”

proposals.speaker: Alden
proposals.following: “That has nothing to do with lodging.”

proposals.speaker: You
proposals.new_html: “You need a room first.” You said.
proposals.following: Alden started laughing. The woman pointed at him.

proposals.speaker: Alden
proposals.new_html: “Do you want me to check?” Alden asked.

proposals.speaker: You
proposals.new_html: “Was that you making me better?” You asked.

proposals.speaker: Jorren
proposals.old_html: “It feels like work when he starts talking.”
proposals.new_html: “It feels like work when he starts talking.” Jorren said.
proposals.current: “It feels like work when he starts talking.”
proposals.following: I ate. The chicken had too much salt. My body did not care. Hunger had apparently been waiting under the beer. Nineteen did that. Need arrived suddenly. Eat now. Sleep now. Move now. Old Greg had been better at ignoring body signals. Or his body had been quieter. Different. Nessa looked at the wrapped regulator under my arm.

proposals.speaker: You
proposals.previous: “You cannot sign other people onto contracts.”
proposals.following: I looked at the clerk. The ink-thumbed clerk looked back at me.

proposals.speaker: She
proposals.previous: “Small utility is fine. Palm-sized Barrier only when necessary, brief. No repeated palm work.”

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.new_html: “Can returns go repair yard?” I asked.

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.new_html: “What needs to remain accessible today?” I asked.

proposals.speaker: Alden
proposals.following: Alden accepted this. We walked back toward the center. At one corner he turned north. I kept east. No discussion. No need. I had four copper, sore legs, clean channels, and mud dried on one knee from losing a fight I had not fought. Tomorrow could wait.

proposals.speaker: She
proposals.following: I looked. He genuinely did not know.

proposals.speaker: He
proposals.old_html: “Because people usually use numbers for time.”
proposals.new_html: “Because people usually use numbers for time.” He said.
proposals.current: “Because people usually use numbers for time.”

proposals.speaker: He
proposals.following: “I was going to ask if you wanted another.”

proposals.speaker: You
proposals.new_html: “Which you are going to ask.” You said.

proposals.speaker: Dema
proposals.following: Good. No argument. I stepped into the yard. This was not what I had planned. I had not planned anything. That helped. Alden moved opposite me.

proposals.speaker: Who
proposals.following: I asked myself before she could. No.

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.previous: “Long enough that you are not carrying pressure, heat, tremor, visual distortion, or channel drag from the first.”

proposals.speaker: Tam
proposals.new_html: “That is not a direction.” Tam said.

proposals.speaker: Pessa
proposals.old_html: “Because then we're repairing one thing while the rest of the route waits.”
proposals.new_html: “Because then we're repairing one thing while the rest of the route waits.” Pessa said.
proposals.current: “Because then we're repairing one thing while the rest of the route waits.”
proposals.following: There. System. Not because repair was impossible. Because scope protected the inspection. I understood. Dangerously.

proposals.speaker: Someone
proposals.old_html: “I need to tell her one cast.”
proposals.new_html: “I need to tell her one cast.” Someone said.
proposals.current: “I need to tell her one cast.”
proposals.following: The woman holding my shoulder said, “You can tell her later.”

proposals.speaker: Hessa
proposals.old_html: “You're trying to turn the yard into a problem you can solve after the answer is already your leg.”
proposals.new_html: “You're trying to turn the yard into a problem you can solve after the answer is already your leg.” Hessa said.
proposals.current: “You're trying to turn the yard into a problem you can solve after the answer is already your leg.”
proposals.following: I stared at her. Too close to therapy. But Hessa looked irritated, not gentle. Better.

proposals.speaker: Who
proposals.previous: “Cart broke through yard plate. Frame shifted. Wheel crushed your leg. Surgeons took it.”

proposals.speaker: Nerin
proposals.old_html: “Then why are you falling into me?”
proposals.new_html: “Then why are you falling into me?” Nerin asked.
proposals.current: “Then why are you falling into me?”

proposals.speaker: Dorn
proposals.old_html: “The job didn't fail because you failed to stop.”
proposals.new_html: “The job didn't fail because you failed to stop.” Dorn said.
proposals.current: “The job didn't fail because you failed to stop.”

proposals.speaker: Jorren
proposals.following: Fair. We sat another minute. Then I stood. Crutches. Right foot. The chair went back on the cart. The lodging was six blocks from the Guild. I knew this in walking time. I did not know it in crutch time. Different unit.

proposals.speaker: Mara
proposals.old_html: “Toma brings it or you go look.”
proposals.new_html: “Toma brings it or you go look.” Mara said.
proposals.previous: “If I need to see a lot physically?”
proposals.current: “Toma brings it or you go look.”
proposals.following: “I may not be able to go look.”

proposals.speaker: Mara
proposals.old_html: “You tell him what to bring. He doesn't tell you what number to write.”
proposals.new_html: “You tell him what to bring. He doesn't tell you what number to write.” Mara said.
proposals.current: “You tell him what to bring. He doesn't tell you what number to write.”

proposals.speaker: Mara
proposals.new_html: “Not accurate enough at crate weight.” Mara said.
proposals.following: Could Toma weigh and report? Independent? Maybe. I needed to see the reading. Could move table? No. Could move chair near scale? Yes. Could I get there? Aisle. Warped board. Twenty-five feet. Flat. Crutches. Possible. I stood. Mara said, “You don't have to.”

proposals.speaker: Sevren
proposals.new_html: “It's everyone's until Nessa charges rent.” Sevren said.
proposals.following: I wanted to go. Immediate. Then body. Distance. Threshold. Seating. Privy. Transport. Late return. Pain. Crutches. People. Fuck. Sevren watched my face.

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.new_html: “I was going to ask when.” I said.

proposals.speaker: Holl
proposals.following: He glared. I smiled. This was fun. I forgot my leg. Actually. For maybe ten minutes. Then I stood. Or tried. Both hands went toward table. Crutches were against wall. Right. Holl caught one before it fell.

proposals.speaker: Holl
proposals.following: “I came because you invited testing conversation.”

proposals.speaker: GREG
proposals.following: He put the satchel on table.

proposals.speaker: Merra
proposals.following: Excellent woman. She gave me blotter, pencil, scrap. No ink.

proposals.speaker: Antonius
proposals.old_html: “Because the job was second count, not theft investigation.”
proposals.new_html: “Because the job was second count, not theft investigation.” Antonius said.
proposals.current: “Because the job was second count, not theft investigation.”

proposals.speaker: Antonius
proposals.old_html: “Anything requiring me to carry while moving.”
proposals.new_html: “Anything requiring me to carry while moving.” Antonius said.
proposals.current: “Anything requiring me to carry while moving.”

proposals.speaker: He
proposals.previous: “Keep both crutches planted if standing distracted. Better, sit.”

proposals.speaker: Alden
proposals.new_html: “Good. I didn't have any.” Alden said.
proposals.following: I stood by pushing through the chair with one hand, caught myself, then stopped.
